sample_unit: patient-style questions on colorectal cancer, each rated by eight colorectal surgeons

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4 colorectal cancer patient education responses (FRE, GFI)
links.effect: Readability scores indicated difficulty (FRE 47.00, GFI 12.40), suggesting a higher educational level was required.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4 outputs to patient-style questions regarding colorectal cancer using expert surgeon scoring and standard quality/readability metrics, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
